messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — planning to enable header-based client gating for the new q-optimizer toggle. Canary target: mobile SDKs >=1.8 at 5% starting tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need alignment on fallback/shim for older clients and guardrails.
Simon: What header name are we using and how will servers treat missing/invalid values?
Maya R: header is `x-rwd-feat-qopt: enable` (value = `enable` or `disable`). Server logic: if header==`enable` -> route to q-optimizer path; if header missing or anything else -> default to old path (no crash). For unknown values log and treat as disabled.
Olivia: For older SDKs that don't set the header, do we want a passive rollout mechanism (server-side cookie/handshake) or ship tiny SDK patch first?
Maya R: Preference is server-first: we will not flip default behavior. For SDKs <1.8 we won't change behavior unless server explicitly opts them in via the new handshake field (coming in a patch). That keeps backward compatibility.
Liam: I have a small shim PR that adds header on fetch — will post the link. We should also include a runtime guard in the SDK: only set header if `sdk.version >= '1.8.0'` and `platform in ['ios','android']`.
Maya R: yes exactly. Example snippet to include in SDKs that will send header:
```js
// in request pipeline
if (sdkVersion >= '1.8.0' && ['ios','android'].includes(platform)) {
  headers['x-rwd-feat-qopt'] = 'enable';
}
```
Simon: Telemetry/metrics? Need metric names and alert thresholds. Also would like a quick regression test for latency.
Maya R: Metrics: `client.qopt.request_count`, `client.qopt.enabled_count`, `client.qopt.error_rate`. Alert if error_rate > 2% for 5m or p95 latency delta > +50ms vs baseline. Will add perf smoke that measures p50/p95.
Olivia: Canary audience details? 5% mobile SDK >=1.8 is fine. Do we want region limits (NA only) for initial run?
Maya R: Good call — NA-only for first 24h. If telemetry healthy, expand to EU then global.
Liam: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — adds header and version guard. Needs review from @Simon and @Olivia.
Simon: Reviewing now, can do an LGTM by EOD assuming unit tests pass.
QA Bot: smoke tests scheduled for tomorrow 08:40 PT against canary group. Runs: basic correctness, latency, and error injection.
DeployBot: Canary rollout preflight OK. Will start enabling 5% in NA at 09:00 PT and report progress in #deployments.
Maya R: Final checklist: (1) Simon/Olivia review PR, (2) QA smoke pass, (3) alerting thresholds created, (4) kill-switch toggle validated in staging. Once all done we flip at 09:00 PT. Please ping in thread when done. :thumbsup:
Liam: Pinged reviewers and fixed a minor lint.
Simon: LGTM, left one nits comment.
Olivia: Approved, added alert rules to the ops dashboard.
Maya R: Thanks — will monitor metrics and post updates here.
DeployBot: Canary rollout started — 5% NA mobile SDK >=1.8. Progress: 0->1->2->3% over 10m window.
Maya R: Monitoring: p95 latency +12ms, error_rate 0.2% — within thresholds. Continuing.
Maya R: Update after 60m: still stable, expanding to EU at 5%.
Maya R: Closing thread for async updates — will file short postmortem if we see regressions.
